rolloutWavePlanner.businessSignal: Rollout is staged by public baseline, dry-run rollback preview, watch lanes, and owner-held lanes instead of flattening the release into one Ready state.

incidentReplayNotebook.businessSignal: Incidents are replayed as false alarms, open questions, or owner-held cases before any watch lane is promoted.

ownerExceptionLedger.businessSignal: Owner exceptions are scoped, expiring records rather than implicit authority to roll out private endpoint or unfreeze behavior.

auditExportDiff.businessSignal: R8.16 export schema changes are visible while private exposure and live write boundaries remain unchanged.

guardrails: Rollout wave planner is a review plan, not production rollout authority.
Incident replay notebook records questions and owner holds without production mutation.
Expired owner exceptions cannot justify rollout or unfreeze claims.
Any private value exposure or non-zero live write blocks the package.
